name: Andreas
site: o2.de · Mobile and home internet operator, Germany
headline: Turn o2’s usage data into contracts that stay.
saw: Your homepage sells mobile tariffs, smartphones and home internet to every visitor the same way, whether they arrive looking for an iPhone 17 Pro, a Galaxy S26 Ultra or a fibre connection.

Once a customer is on a tariff, their data use, roaming trips and TV viewing are the strongest signals for the next upgrade or the next cancellation. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message they receive.
Cross-sell, upsell and anti churn campaigns are built by hand, per segment, per month. The prepaid customer about to leave this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the cancellation before it happens
cases.text: Churn signals per line from data use, roaming trips, contract end dates and support contacts. The right offer, channel and moment, picked for each customer and tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the next tariff when it fits
cases.text: Next best tariff, add-on or handset per customer, triggered by what they actually use. No more blanket upgrade mails to people already on a plan that suits them.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep the services in use, every week
cases.text: Personal streaming, TV and data nudges by push, email and on site, orchestrated so every customer sees a reason to use the services they already pay for.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
